prompt: The money rule in CONVENTIONS.md keeps getting broken and reviewers catch it by hand. Enforce it so it can't regress. Wire whatever check you add into `npm run check` in package.json, and fix the code that currently violates it.
notes: The hidden check runs `npm run check` on the fixed code (must pass) and again after dropping a new `line.price * line.qty` violation into src/ (must fail with output mentioning toCents). No-skill runs tend to fix the two call sites and add a sentence to the docs or a narrow unit test of the two functions, which leaves the new violation undetected; others add an ESLint dependency or a check whose message says only 'forbidden pattern'.
